visualReview.notes: Actually inspected all63 final images:14 portable,14 shared and35 medium-fi. Whole turntables show three rounded silver cores, three green curtain-wall office wings, nine staggered garden recesses, flat stepped crown and open red/white lattice mast. Fine vertical mullions and horizontal silver spandrels now remain visible after removing the opaque glazing underlay that initially hid concave bands. Garden detail views show vegetation behind structural bars and substantial recess depth. The mapped western main entrance has paired dark glass doors, thin frame, handles and a visible recess through the outer facade. Dedicated overhead images show the triangular central atrium roof below the three higher wing caps. Legacy sloped-crown camera name remains, but its final image shows the corrected flat roof. Dedicated whole cameras include the complete tower and mast; narrow default facade cameras intentionally crop upper sections. No missing tower section observed in final images.

mediumFiReview.notes: Actually inspected noon/late economy/high views, facade and garden cameras, explicit whole views for all four levels, overhead atrium, mapped entry and four level transitions. All levels preserve the triangular base, three separate cores, nine garden recesses, flat highest crown and open mast. Skyline omits individual office floors and fine mullions while retaining garden vegetation and atrium cap. District retains horizontal bands and fewer vertical strips, using crossed flat structural members. Street retains facade grid, all gardens and lattice with four-sided small members; closeup keeps fine framing and six-sided members. Cotswold cottage neighbors are a valid shipped style fixture, not a reconstruction of Frankfurt surroundings. Lighting and shadow quality changes remain readable. Night and physical-device performance unmeasured.

limitations: Complete medium-fi tower includes rounded triangular base, three occupied wings around central atrium, nine staggered four-storey garden volumes, three rounded service cores, western tall flat-roof crown and red/white open lattice antenna to300m. Original54151-triangle recipe remains unchanged and reproducible. Engineer photograph and award section show flat stepped corner cores and lattice mast; reviewed source replaces the original sloping glass crown and solid mast approximation, while keeping mapped component positions. Arup publishes259m architectural height,160m atrium,nine15m gardens alternating30m offices; professional registry publishes300m tip and190m occupied height. Counts differ between architect53storeys and engineer50above-ground/45office; no literal floor-count claim. Three garden schedules and15m depth remain reconstruction using mapped coarse strata, not a surveyed schedule. Broad rounded cores use silver shared painted-metal panels and narrow reconstructed vertical dark strips; outer office curtain walls use opaque palette PBR glazing. Garden exterior transparent glass is omitted around structural bars to keep vegetation/recess readable; it is a deliberate abstraction, not literal exterior open air. Source trees are original medium-fi foliage. Named Große Gallusstraße19 entry belongs to base, receives reconstructed glazing/recess and small threshold; hardware and grade unmeasured. Separate perimeter historic block, galleria interior, neighboring restored structures, public cafés, basements and interiors are outside this tower bundle. Official award interior images support galleria context only. Exact service fittings, logos, mast lights, panel joints, plant species and garden furniture are simplified or omitted. Night illumination, real grade and physical-device performance unmeasured.
